caption: A cascade sends every request to the cheap model first and escalates only when a check fails; it pays off only if most requests pass at the cheap tier.
alt: A request goes to a small, cheap model. Its draft answer is checked in code: does it cite the context, is the format valid, is it not marked unsure. If the checks pass the draft is returned. If they fail, the same request goes to the large, capable model, and that answer is returned. The escalation rate decides whether the cascade saves money.

nodes.label: Worth it only if most requests stop here
